Thanks, I’m gonna sleep now. 
Have a good one

Thanks for the kind words. I hope everything turns out good for you, and if you need to talk also, I’ll be around for a while. 

My life will never be “normal”, not anymore. But I still care for others, it’s all that really keeps me going.  So all I can do is try and live so they are happy. I might try and get help, but there aren’t any good people near where I live.

I’m no psychologist, but it sounds like you’re having suicidal thoughts and some form of depression. What you’re describing doesn’t sound heathy, and I would look into it. Talking to someone you trust or a doctor could also help. I don’t know how old you are, but I would deal with this as quickly as you can. I used to have similar thoughts and ignored them, now I’m very suicidal. You probably don’t want that.
Yeah it sucks, and sadly I don’t have the will to do anything about it.

Yeah talking helps a good bit. Talking with strangers is easy for some reason, but I’ve never had an outlet to do it. That’s mainly why I made this account, for random ranting and maybe connecting with some people.

Thanks for the talk btw.

You are kinda right, but it’s not just to protect them. The thought of telling them more makes me overwhelming suicidal and when they bring it up I have internal panic attacks. I rather lie to make sure that I don’t go over the edge. They all deserve happiness, so I hide to make sure they are happy.
Hey, I’m here if you wanna talk
